audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 holds: Wind Wall deletes Crescent Strike, which is the ability every other part of your kit keys off, and Sweeping Blade re-enters any trade off minions on a 0.5s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Rating kept; difficulty now stated through the wall timer and the minion-dash rather than as a vibe.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Yasuo/Yasuo/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Yasuo; content win[] and the packet chart agree on Diana/Diana/Yasuo/Diana/Diana/Yasuo/Diana.
audit.why: Content and packet match each other exactly, so full was the stale layer. Rows 2 and 5 genuinely go to Yasuo — level 3 Wind Wall (25s) eats the crescent your combo needs, and his first crit item plus a knock-up out-trades your burst.
audit.corrected: All seven sides aligned to win[]; phases[2].why and phases[5].why rewritten in the same proposal to describe Yasuo winning those stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wind Wall's 4-second duration and 25s-to-17s cooldown were never stated, nor that Last Breath requires an Airborne target, nor that Sweeping Blade recycles at 0.5s off minions.
audit.why: Riot's text: the wall blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds; Last Breath blinks to an Airborne enemy champion; Sweeping Blade is 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1s and dashes through any target enemy.
audit.corrected: All three now appear in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2], dontsFull[2] and breakdown.carry.

audit.corrected: Wind Wall 25s/17s and 4s duration, Last Breath 70s to 30s, Steel Tempest 4s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); dosFull[0]/[2] and dontsFull[0] were generic filler under specific titles. content spikes[3] wrote 'windwall' as one lowercase word.

packet suspectNames flagged 'His Last Breath' in spikes[1].text as a probable wrong name. It is a false positive — Last Breath is the real ultimate name and 'His' is just the preceding word.

edits.before: E pull joins... no — your dash threat begins: Q-mark into E reset chases are live; trade on every landed crescent.
edits.after: Level 3 he has Wind Wall: 25s of it eats Crescent Strike outright, and no mark means no free Lunar Rush.

edits.before: First item spike: the mark-dash combo chunks half bars and the reset chains through waves.
edits.after: His first crit item plus a 21s Wind Wall out-trades your burst if he lands a knock-up.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Pale Cascade for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, 17s at rank 5, and it stands 4 seconds — Crescent Strike is a projectile, so hold Q until the wall expires. - Last Breath is 70s at rank 1 but only 30s at rank 3; Steel Tempest recycles every 4s.

edits.before: Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Your passive cleaves on every third strike — land the string, then step out before Steel Tempest cycles in 4s.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: Pale Cascade shields on cast — save the orbs for his Sweeping Blade follow-up rather than spending them on the walk in.

edits.before: Yasuo whiffs Wind Wall and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Last Breath needs an Airborne target — spend yours after his.

edits.before: That is Yasuo’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Steel Tempest costs no mana on a 4s cycle — a long brawl is the fight he is built for.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Sweeping Blade dashes off minions at 0.5s and he re-enters the trade at will — his own wave is his mobility engine.

edits.before: Yasuo wins by landing Wind Wall, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Yasuo wins by walling your Crescent Strike, dashing back in on Sweeping Blade, and answering a knock-up with Last Breath.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Yasuo needs an Airborne target for Last Breath — deny knock-ups, then Moonfall his team while he is out of it.

edits.before: Once he's fed and fully stacked on crit, his windwall completely denies your engage tools and his damage output in a straight fight becomes very threatening.
edits.after: Once he's fed and fully stacked on crit, his Wind Wall on a 17s timer denies your engage tools and his damage output in a straight fight becomes very threatening.

notes: packet suspectNames 'His Last Breath' is a false positive — Last Breath is correct. Full-layer sides were stale on all seven rows against a content chart that already matched the packet exactly; rows 2 and 5 moved to Yasuo and both whys were rewritten to match in the same proposal. Wind Wall blocking Crescent Strike is asserted throughout the existing page and is stated here; note the owner kit file does not carry a 'projectile' flag on Diana's Q, so this rests on the wall's 'blocks all enemy projectiles' text rather than a flag. tradeGood/tradeBad left alone.
